chapter.verse: Keimah in kisaktheihna ka bawl ding a kilawm loh hangin ka bawl ding hi. Ahih hangin Topa hong muhsak mangmatna leh thupiakkholhna thu kong gen ding hi.
Tuma kum sawm leh li lai takin Khazih sungah a om mi khat, thumna vantung dongin a paipih ka thei hi. Ama pumpi tonpih hiam, tonpih lo hiam ka thei kei hi—Pasian in a thei hi.
Tuapa Paradis khua-ah a paipih hi. Mite gen dinga kilawm lo, kigen thei lo kam a zakna thu a thei hi.
A pumpi a thei hiam, thei lo hiam ka thei kei hi—Pasian in a thei hi.
Tua bang mi hangin ka kisathei ding hi. Keimah pumpi a hih leh, thanemna sim loh, ka kisathei kei ding hi.

Kisathei nuam hi leng zong mihai ka hi kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in a man takin thu ka gen ding hi. Midang khat in kei hong muh sangin, ka thu a zak sangin, keimah hong up zawk loh nadingin gen loin ka om ding hi.
Ka ngah mangmatnate a lamdan’ mahmah hangin kisaktheihna lungsim ka neih loh nadingin kei hong daantat na’ng Satan’ sawltak ahi, ka pum hong sun ling khat hong pia hi.
Tua zawn’khalna tawh kipelh nadingin Topa kiangah thum vei dongin ka ngen hi.

Ka thuum khit ciangin, “Ka hehpihna thupha in nang ading a kicing hi, ka vangliatna in thanemna ah a kicing hi,” ci-in thu hong pia hi. Tua ahih ciangin Khazih’ vangliatna in kei tungah hong tun’ nadingin ka thanemna hangin ka kisaktheih zawk nading ka utzaw hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Khazih hangin thanemna, kosiatna, zawn’khalna, bawlsiatna, a haksa gimna ka thuak ciangin ka nuam hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka thanem ciangin ka thahat hi.

Mihai ka suak zo hi! Note in kei, zawhthawhna tawh mihai nong suaksak zo uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note phatna ngah ding ka kilawm hi. Keimah in bangmah ka hih loh hangin sawltak a lian belte nuaiah neukha beek a gina lozaw ka hi kei hi.
Ahi takpi-in na khempeuh ah thuakna tawh nalamdangte leh dipkuat huaite, vangliatnate tawh, sawltakte’ lim note lakah a kilang khinzo hi.
Keimah in note ading vangik ka suah lohna sim loh, note in pawlpi dangte sangin bangah a gina lozaw na hi uh hiam? Tua bang ka khialhna hong maisak un.

Thum veina note kiangah hong pai dingin a kigingin ka om hi. Ahih hangin note’ adingin vangik ka hi kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, note neihsate deihin, a zong ka hi kei hi, nomau mahmah kong zong hi. Tanute tapate in a nu a pate ading sum khol ahi kei uh hi; a nute a pate in a tanute a tapate ading sum a khol uh hi.

Keimah in note kha uh nopsak nadingin ka neihsate ahi zongin, ka pumpi ahi zongin, lungdamna tawh ka beisak nuam hi. Keimah in note a tam zaw-in kong it leh, note in kei a tawm zaw-in nong it ding uh hiam?
Keimah in note tungah vangik khat ka suah lohna maan ta hen. Ahi zongin mipil ka hih ciangin kheemna tawh note hong man hi ta leng zong,
note kiangah ka hong paisak mi khatpeuh tung tawnin note’ neihsa kheemna tawh la ngei ka hi hiam?

Titu in note kiangah a pai nading ka thuum a, amah tawh i sanggampa khat kong paisak hi. Titu in kheemna tawh note sum a la hiam? Kote in lungsim kibangin a gamta hilo ka hi uh hiam? Lam khat bek zui hilo ka hi uh hiam?

Kote in note mai-ah tu dongin kisuan’takna kampau hi ci-in nong um uh hiam? Khazih sungah kipin Pasian mai-ah ka gen uh hi. Ahih hangin ka itte aw, ko ka hihna uh na khempeuh note kipsak nadingin ka hih uh hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka hong tun’ ciangin note in ka deih mi na hih loh uh a, keimah in zong no deih loh mi hi ding ahi zongin, note lakah kitotna, gendaina, nakpi-a hehna, kiseelna, kiphunsanna, kikhenna, kiphatsak theihna, buaina a suah ding ahi zongin,

nidang hunin khialin kihhuai gamtatna, numei tawh mawhna, huk luatna, lan luatnate hih kha-in, tu dongin kisik lo-a om mi tampi hangin lungsim nuam loin ka thuum a, note mai-ah ka Pasian in kei hong niamkhiatin amaute hanga hong kidahsak khak ding ka lau hi.
